page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines. Library stamp and show-through from the reverse side are left out. A small woodcut or engraving sits lower down, under the stamp, and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The title is faint and partly shows through from the reverse; several words are doubtful (notably "IOCKNBEEK", "Armachani", "Synodos", "SLOTIS"). The imprint at the foot is too faint to read. The lines marked "(Una", "(cum" and "(Ima" are small, italic or ornamental fragments, and "Addita ad" is set in italic.
